hero.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate · Hero, Yggdrasil’s Altar
hero.label: 슈퍼 스매시브라더스 얼티밋 · 용사
hero.evidence: Hero and alternate costumes in actual combat; held MP and spell effects visible. Do not label any shown menu as Command Selection. Its mechanic is depicted in the independent diagram and confirmed by Nintendo.

mechanics.evidence: The Nintendo DLC page confirms a random selection of spells. Peach’s angle-dependent choice is retained as the reference teaching role and illustrated with independently drawn generic tools. The seed comparison runs our own small deterministic generator.
